title: Publish FFTA DE-ReBuild 1.1.1
changes: Publish release 1.1.1 with notes describing the initial Android feature-parity work, validation and remaining limitations.
validation: GitHub reports v1.1.1 as public and latest, with tag d89bb7949c3f6596f31efcd84623c9ec87078780. All nine uploaded assets matched staged sizes and SHA-256 digests.
Remote main and decomp were fast-forwarded to the release source commit. Android version code 26 was built with the existing preview signing certificate.
limitations: Android remains a debug-signed preview. Real-game state transfer, undo and cartridge backup restoration on a phone remain unverified. Windows validation used Wine.
